caption:
Third overall at Trilogía. The race demanded everything the mountains had to offer over three days, but the real lesson wasn't in the speed — it was in the quiet resolve required to keep moving when the legs started to argue. Endurance is rarely about the podium; it is the sum of every small, disciplined choice made long before the starting line. When you stop racing against the field and start running with the terrain, the mountain stops being an adversary and becomes a partner.
